look.summary_zh: 中性 · 中灰近原值 · 中段跨度接近原值
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 127.6/255（变化 +0.1 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 1.057。中灰红减蓝 -1.0 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #F1D9C5、#D19D79、#825033；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #CE2C26、#32CE33、#2E2CCB。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 127.6/255 (+0.1 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.057; mid-gray red minus blue -1.0 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #F1D9C5, #D19D79, #825033. Red/green/blue swatches: #CE2C26, #32CE33, #2E2CCB.
look.suggested_use_zh: 产品、生活与风景对照试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
